VERIVA explores how personalised breakfast guidance and creator-led food stories can introduce oats to new everyday routines.

This is the public introduction to our classroom app. Account-based AI and saved projects run in the separate app prototype.

01

A breakfast that fits.

The app uses your preferences, available time and optional health records to inform breakfast recommendations.

02

A conversation that helps.

A recipe-aware DeepSeek assistant answers breakfast questions. Review suggested recipe adjustments before saving your own version.

03

A little feedback, a better next bowl.

Tell the app if a recipe is too sweet, bland, thick or thin. Its adjustment workflow helps refine future preparation.

FROM ONE BOWL TO ANOTHER

The classroom prototype connects recipes to creative cards, editable shot lists, saved projects and a filming checklist. Creators can share a food-only recipe card and invite others to try their own variation.
